notes.title: Major Update v1.1.0
notes.content:
[h2]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44722929/41bb4fc5abcf0cacf3ae8013575388c26ca49dfb.png"][/img][/h2][h2]Marathon Mode is Live![/h2][p]If you were looking for a better way to speedrun the entire game, this is for you! Marathon Mode will take you through all 20 trials back-to-back and allow you to compete on a new leaderboard.[/p][p]Similar to the final golden chest, [b]Marathon Mode is unlocked by getting gold on all trials[/b]. To start Marathon Mode, [b]go down the staircase behind the golden chest under the temple[/b]. There you will find a floating book stack that can be interacted with to start a marathon![/p][p]This update also has several changes to early game trails to hopefully increase visibility of shortcuts, however, level flow has been left largely unchanged.[/p][p][/p][h3]Changes[/h3][list][*][p][b]Marathon mode[/b] (located in new room below temple - requires gold on all trials)[/p][/*][*][p]Added marathon timer showing total time elapsed in a marathon (including restarts and deaths). Also shows delta time between your best marathon and the current marathon (only appears on consecutive runs of marathon mode)[/p][/*][*][p]Front Gate I trial revisions (hidden scroll and present moved)[/p][/*][*][p]Grasslands I trial revisions (hidden scroll moved)[/p][/*][*][p]Grasslands III trial revisions (hidden scroll moved [i]slightly[/i])[/p][/*][*][p]Grasslands VI trial revisions (hidden scroll and present moved)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Leaderboard upload reattempts[/b]. If your leaderboard entry (time and/or ghost) fails to upload, try replaying the level. As long as the save data is not tampered with, a reupload will be attempted. This should work if you get records offline, without internet, or if Steam services are down.[/p][/*][*][p]Present and scroll particles upgraded and proximity sound added for better discoverability[/p][/*][*][p]Added banner dropdown when a hidden scroll is opened[/p][/*][*][p]Updated models for the start and stop targets in the trial buildings (the stop target is now a stop sign and the start target is less blocky)[/p][/*][*][p]Various bug fixes regarding ghost selection[/p][/*][*][p]Various tweaks to how level selection works in order to support Marathon Mode[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where particles from hidden scrolls and presents would stop on trial quick restart[/p][/*][*][p]Various tweaks to destructible positioning (fixed wall clipping, floating items, etc.)[/p][/*][/list][p]Also, I'm hoping to have German and Russian translation updates out this week.[/p][p][/p][p]Let me know what you think or if you encounter any issues! [/p][p]And as always, have fun![/p]

notes.title: Minor Patch v1.0.5
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44722929/9e99bc586f1a49edacee013cf55a1180a689dece.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This is a small patch focused mainly on localization improvements.[/p][p]I know these aren’t the most exciting updates, but I want to make sure that players who buy the game expecting their language get a proper experience with as few errors as possible. Some translations have not been up to my standards, and I’m working to correct that.[/p][p]The good news: progress is being made! English, Spanish, and French have now been reviewed and updated. I’m currently lining up help for Russian and Chinese, and I’ve reached out to a local publisher to assist with German, Italian, and Portuguese. Hopefully I’ll have more to share soon.[/p][p]Please note this doesn’t mean the updated languages are perfect, but the number of errors should be much lower than before. If you spot anything off, or just want to share general feedback, you’ll now find a [b]“Send Feedback”[/b] button in the settings menu, which links to a Google Form.[/p][h3]Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Spanish localization reviewed and updated[/p][/*][*][p]French localization reviewed and updated[/p][/*][*][p]Minor English grammar fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Send Feedback[/b] button to settings menu[/p][/*][*][p]Added a metal grate above the diamond unlock area (For easier discoverability) [/p][/*][/list][p]Also, I am looking into making a Discord server, more on that soon hopefully![/p][p]Thank you all once again for playing and supporting the game![/p]

notes.title: Minor Patch v1.0.4
notes.content:
Firstly, thank you to everyone who has played so far! Seeing your ghosts running across the levels has been an amazing experience. I hope you are enjoying yourselves!

This is a minor update fixing several small issues:

- Changed default FOV to 90 (I recommend most people play at this FOV, makes the game feel a little faster!)
- Various tweaks to Spanish localization (still in progress)
- Moved the position of a tutorial scroll in the tutorial level for better visibility
- Adjusted positioning of various destructible across levels
